PropMv - Property Management API (1.0.0)

Download OpenAPI specification:

PropMv Dev Team: support@propmv.io

API for PropMv property management platform. Contains Authentication & Access Control, and feature groups for Landlord Portal and HOA Board Portal.

Auth

Sign up a new user

Registers a new user (landlord, tenant, HOA board member, etc.) along with role-specific profile details.

email

string <email>
password

string
confirmPassword
required
string
firstName
required
string
lastName
required
string
phone
string
roleId
required
string
object
